claim: The Known Expert OS 12-phase card is transcribed into an executable phase harness in which the truncated Phase 11 and the absent Phase 12 can never be reported as passed.
Certify gates carry a planted mutation that must turn them RED, so a gate that cannot go red is caught as theater instead of trusted.
A ROADMAP packet prefix with no matching proof hash on disk is reported missing rather than silently credited.
Resume use is refused in code for any claim that is not direct, sits below the 0.8 confidence floor, or names an evidence path that does not resolve.
The 2031 system specifies a weekly Realign driver with C_t/A_t convergence scoring; it is not running yet.
Three of the nine 2031 source cards are truncated on disk, so no capability score may be derived from their missing regions.
